 "content": "from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Full-width / full-height solid lines mark the panel boundaries.
    row_lines = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    # Keep only lines whose color is distinct from the ordinary panel background.
    all_vals = [v for row in grid for v in row]
    background = Counter(all_vals).most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_lines = [r for r in row_lines if grid[r][0] != background]
    col_lines = [c for c in col_lines if grid[0][c] != background]
    rbounds = [-1] + row_lines + [h]
    cbounds = [-1] + col_lines + [w]
    panels = []
    for ri in range(len(rbounds) - 1):
        r0, r1 = rbounds[ri] + 1, rbounds[ri + 1]
        for ci in range(len(cbounds) - 1):
            c0, c1 = cbounds[ci] + 1, cbounds[ci + 1]
            panel = [row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
            count = sum(v != background for row in panel for v in row)
            panels.append((count, r0, r1, c0, c1, panel))
    source = max(panels, key=lambda p: p[0])
    _, _, _, _, _, motif = source
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for _, r0, r1, c0, c1, _ in panels:
        for rr in range(r1 - r0):
            for cc in range(c1 - c0):
                out[r0 + rr][c0 + cc] = motif[rr][cc]
    return out
